# Comprehensive Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Safety Training for the Oil & Gas Industry

> 4-hour operations-level online hydrogen sulfide safety course for oil and gas (rigs, completions, production, pipelines, refineries), in accordance with ANSI/ASSP Z390.1-2024 and API RP 49 and 55. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 4 hours; 5 modules, 13 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.4 CEU
- Price: $199.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and on-site formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 1 year (ANSI Z390.1 calls for annual retraining)
- Standards covered: ANSI/ASSP Z390.1-2024; API RP 49 and 55; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 and 1926; BSEE 30 CFR 250.490

## Key U.S. H2S exposure limits
- OSHA construction PEL: 10 ppm, 8-hour TWA
- OSHA general industry ceiling: 20 ppm
- OSHA general industry peak: 50 ppm, up to 10 minutes once per 8-hour shift if no other measurable exposure
- NIOSH IDLH: 100 ppm

## Modules
1. Introduction to Hydrogen Sulfide and Safety Regulations (overview of H2S, regulations, health effects)
2. Risk Assessment, Safety Culture, and Detection (risk assessment, detection and monitoring, using a gas monitor)
3. Hazard Control and Safe Work Practices (hazard controls, safe work practices, PPE)
4. Respiratory Safety and Equipment Management (respiratory protection, respirator use and maintenance)
5. Advanced Risk Management and Emergency Response (oil and gas risk management, emergency response and first aid)

## Who should take it
Oil and gas workers in drilling, extraction and refining; pipeline operators and maintenance staff; sewage and wastewater treatment workers; chemical and petrochemical plant employees; manufacturing workers exposed to hazardous gases; safety managers; emergency responders; contractors at oil, gas and industrial sites.
